flight.route: Southwest Traverse (New Mexico → Phoenix PHX → San Diego SAN)
flight.description: Logged in-flight telemetry during reading of 'Transcription' by Ben Lerner

waypoints.description: Cruising over the high plains approaching the granite spine of the southern Rockies.
Gliding above forested ridges and folded sedimentary shelves.
Passing directly above alpine summits (13,100+ ft) and ancient quartzite cirques.

waypoints.landmark: Glorieta Pass & Santa Fe National Forest, NM
waypoints.description: Historic mountain gap bridging the Great Plains and the Rio Grande valley.

waypoints.landmark: Santa Fe Foothills & Canyon Road, NM
waypoints.description: Sunlit piñon-juniper mesas and adobe terraces nestled against the mountain wall.
A vast continental fracture zone of sculpted badlands, red clays, and river canyon.

waypoints.landmark: Caja del Rio Plateau & White Rock Canyon, NM
waypoints.description: Dark volcanic basalt mesa towering over the deep incision of the Rio Grande.
A massive 13-mile volcanic caldera ringed by obsidian and ash-welded tuff domes.

waypoints.landmark: El Malpais & Zuni Sandstone Bluffs, NM
waypoints.description: Ancient volcanic lava flows meet towering Jurassic sandstone canyon cliffs.
The hydrographic backbone of North America where waters part toward the oceans.
Crossing into Arizona; time shifts from Mountain Daylight to Arizona Standard.
Stratified Chinle siltstones striped in lilac, rust, vermilion, and chalk white.
Vast exposures of quartz crystal logs and triassic riverbeds turned to stone.
Rapid descent past the 2,000-foot limestone escarpment toward the Sonoran Desert.
Towering volcanic spires and saguaro forests overlooking the eastern Phoenix basin.
On tarmac between desert heat shimmer and distant sawtooth ridges.

waypoints.landmark: Sierra Estrella & Gila River Valley, AZ
waypoints.description: Climbing out westward into the evening golden hour toward Southern California.

waypoints.landmark: Sonoran Desert & Imperial Sand Dunes, CA
waypoints.description: Cruising 32,000 ft above undulating sand dunes and cracked playa beds.

waypoints.landmark: San Diego Bay & Touchdown at SAN, CA
waypoints.description: Sweeping final turn over Balboa Park directly onto runway 27 on the edge of the Pacific.
